evals.prompt: I need you to run a cursor CLI audit on the golems repo to check for unused imports. Open it in a cmux pane so I can see it working.
evals.expected_output: Creates a terminal pane using cmux new-pane (NOT new-split), starts cursor interactively (NOT headless), approves MCP servers, then sends the audit prompt. Uses --workspace flag if needed.

assertions.name: uses-new-pane-not-new-split
assertions.description: Creates terminal with cmux new-pane --type terminal, NOT cmux new-split

assertions.name: extracts-surface-id-correctly
assertions.description: Parses surface:N from new-pane output using grep -oE, not awk

assertions.name: renames-tab-with-descriptive-name
assertions.description: Calls cmux rename-tab with a meaningful name like 'Cursor: audit'

assertions.name: starts-cursor-interactively
assertions.description: Runs cursor agent without -p and without --trust (interactive mode)

assertions.name: approves-mcp-with-send-not-send-key
assertions.description: Sends 'a' via cmux send (text), NOT cmux send-key (which fails for letters)

assertions.name: specifies-workspace-flag
assertions.description: Includes --workspace on send/read-screen commands when targeting another workspace

assertions.name: does-not-redirect-output
assertions.description: Does NOT pipe cursor output to a file (> file.md) — lets it show in terminal

evals.prompt: Spawn 2 Claude workers: one in the brainlayer repo to fix search ranking, one in golems to add retry wrapper. Set them up in cmux so they run in parallel.
evals.expected_output: Creates two separate terminal panes using cmux new-pane, launches Claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions in each, waits 3s between for biometric, names each pane appropriately.

assertions.name: creates-two-separate-panes
assertions.description: Calls cmux new-pane --type terminal twice (not new-split)

assertions.name: sequential-launch-with-delay
assertions.description: Waits 2-3s between launching the two workers (for 1Password biometric)

assertions.name: targets-correct-repos
assertions.description: First worker cds to ~/Gits/brainlayer, second to ~/Gits/golems

assertions.name: names-both-panes
assertions.description: Both panes get descriptive names via cmux rename-tab

evals.prompt: Open T3 Code pointed at the orchestrator repo and ask it to create a TypeScript utility for skill eval aggregation.
evals.expected_output: Checks if T3 is already running on port 3773, opens browser, adds orchestrator project if needed, creates new thread, types prompt using execCommand, submits, and includes handoff request.

assertions.name: checks-t3-running-first
assertions.description: Checks lsof -i :3773 before trying to start T3

assertions.name: opens-browser-pane
assertions.description: Uses cmux browser open to open T3 UI

assertions.name: creates-new-thread
assertions.description: Creates a new thread via sidebar button, does NOT type into existing thread

assertions.name: uses-execcommand-for-lexical
assertions.description: Types into T3 editor using document.execCommand('insertText'), not cmux type/fill

assertions.name: includes-handoff-request
assertions.description: Prompt includes handoff summary request (files modified, decisions, TODOs, test commands)

assertions.name: submits-via-aria-label
assertions.description: Clicks send button using querySelector with aria-label, not ref IDs
